text:
Maria - Sales: Hey team, Concord (prospect) asked for a POC perf run this week — they want sustained inference numbers for their chatbot: target 300 qps steady, 1k burst, 99th latency < 600ms. Can we confirm an ops plan?
Jamie (SE): I can own the test harness. Plan: k6 for HTTP steady-state + short burst script, 30m steady then 10m spike. Will need an endpoint with stable model pin and KV cache enabled.
Alex S: For cost and repeatability we should use Dedicated pool with a pin to model v2.1-quant. That avoids noisy neighbors. Will that be ok for Concord?
Maria - Sales: They prefer hosted if possible, but will accept Dedicated for SLA. Pricing question from their procurement: rough monthly cost if they sustain 300 qps for 24/7 vs a reserved pool — any back-of-envelope?
Oliver (SRE): Back-of-envelope: sustaining 300 qps on ded pool (N4 GPU equivalent) ~ 3.2M tokens/day -> ~ $X,XXX/day hosted. Reserved capacity discount ~30% depending on commit. I'll ping finance for exact quote.
Priya - Security: Concord's security team asked about KMS for keys and VPC peering. For a Dedicated POC we can offer customer-managed KMS + private networking. Need a short answers doc for their questionnaire.
Jamie (SE): Test details:
```
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 30m steady.js 
# then spike: k6 run --vus 1000 --duration 10m spike.js
```
steady.js will target 300 qps overall with pacing. We'll sample p50/p95/p99 and token counts per request.
Maria - Sales: Good. Can SRE provision a dedicated endpoint with model pinned to v2.1-quant and KV cache on? Also enable request tracing so we can attach per-request latency to traces.
Oliver (SRE): Yep. I'll spin up a small ded pool and hand off an endpoint URL by EOD. Setting: autoscale off, pinned replica count 6, cache TTL 5m for prefixes. Tracing enabled via x-trace-id header.
Maria - Sales: Concord also wants an example load script and a short runbook we can hand to their infra folks. Jamie, can you author both?
Jamie (SE): On it. I'll include validation checks (p99 < 600ms) + fallback plan: if p99 > 800ms then switch to smaller sequence length and enable model_variant fallback to v2.1-quant-fast.
Alex S: Quick note on billing while running: enable token-level metering and export CSV after runs. We'll need token counts per-second to feed into the pricing calc.
deploy-bot: Deployment: dedicated/pools/concord-poc created by oliver — endpoint ready at https://ded.redwood.example/concord-poc (status: healthy).
Oliver (SRE): Endpoint handed off. Running warmup with a small load now. Expect green by 14:10 PT.
Maria - Sales: Great. Concord wants initial results within 24h. Let's aim for 2 runs (AM steady + PM sustained stress) and deliver a one-pager with p50/p95/p99, throughput, and cost estimate.
Jamie (SE): After the first steady 30m run I see: p50=62ms, p95=210ms, p99=480ms, throughput steady at 305 qps, avg tokens/request 120. Will run the spike in ~20m.
Priya - Security: For the questionnaire: I'll drop a 2-paragraph note about KMS and audit logs and attach our SOC2 doc. Ping me if they ask for HSM specifically.
Oliver (SRE): Spike run done. Observed: sustained 1k qps for 7m, tail moved: p99 peaked at 1.1s during the highest tail microbursts but settled to ~520ms under stable 1k qps. We throttled coldstart concurrency to avoid node churn.
Maria - Sales: Summarize for Concord: steady pass, spike shows transient tail >600ms but steady-state meets their 99th target when smoothed. Include mitigation suggestions: reserved pool + prefix caching + small sequence length cap.
Jamie (SE): I'll assemble the one-pager + raw CSVs and send to Concord with suggested next steps (dedicated commitment or routing policy to fallback to fast variant).
Maria - Sales: Thanks — please cc me and Priya on the send. Good job team :thumbsup:
Jamie (SE): Will do. File artifacts: /artifacts/concord/6378123456/steady.csv, /artifacts/concord/6378123456/spike.csv, and runbook.md attached in the email.
Maria - Sales: Closing note for internal: ask finance for a 3-month reserved quote and include a POC discount line item. Oliver, can you mark this POC as 'billing: metered' for now?
Oliver (SRE): Marked. I'll follow up with cost numbers once finance responds.
Maria - Sales: End of thread.
